description: A farmer decides to move his cows to a nearby farm using helicopters and trucks. A helicopter can take 3 cows per trip and creates 5 units of pollution. A truck can take 7 cows per trip and creates 10 units of pollution. The farmer needs to transport 80 cows and he only has enough money for at most 8 truck trips. How many of each type of trip should be taken to minimize the total amount of pollution produced?

TotalCows.definition: The total number of cows that need to be transported

HelicopterCapacity.definition: The number of cows that a helicopter can transport per trip

HelicopterPollution.definition: The amount of pollution created by a helicopter per trip

TruckCapacity.definition: The number of cows that a truck can transport per trip

TruckPollution.definition: The amount of pollution created by a truck per trip

MaxTruckTrips.definition: The maximum number of truck trips that can be made due to budget constraints

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of pollution produced by the helicopter and truck trips used to transport the cows"

constraints.description: 3 * (number of helicopter trips) + 7 * (number of truck trips) >= TotalCows
0 <= number of truck trips <= MaxTruckTrips, and number of truck trips must be an integer
number of helicopter trips >= 0 and must be an integer

HelicopterTrips.definition: The number of helicopter trips taken to transport the cows

TruckTrips.definition: The number of truck trips taken to transport the cows
